title: God Is in Control
shortDescription: There are moments when we try to carry too much: outcomes, people, decisions, timing, and scenarios that do not depend entirely on us. This three-day journey will help you distinguish between responsibility and control, remember God's faithful rule, and learn to rest without neglecting obedience. It is not about abandoning your duties, but about living with peace knowing that the final weight of the story does not rest on your shoulders.

title: Peace in the Midst of the Storm
shortDescription: There are seasons when everything seems to be moving at once: unexpected problems, difficult news, conflicts, losses, or urgent decisions. Biblical peace does not mean denying the storm or waiting for everything to calm down before trusting. Over six days, you will learn to recognize what you are going through, remember God's presence, bring order to your inner life, pray from the chaos, act with wisdom, and remain anchored in a peace that does not depend entirely on circumstances.

title: When God Seems Not to Answer
shortDescription: There are prayers that seem to remain suspended in the air. We ask, wait, and ask again, but the answer does not come as we imagined. This five-day journey will help you walk through that tension without blaming yourself, without trying to manipulate God with formulas, and without turning delay into a verdict. You will learn to pray honestly, examine your expectations, recognize answers that may come in a different way, and persevere with a faith that rests in God's character.

title: Praying Until You Find Peace
shortDescription: There are moments when we pray and the heart remains restless. Circumstances do not change immediately, questions remain, and the mind returns to the same things again and again. This ten-day journey will help you turn prayer into a place of surrender, truth, gratitude, silence, and trust. It is not about repeating words until you force an emotion, but about remaining before God until you learn to rest in his presence even while some answers are still pending.

title: Prayers for Difficult Days
shortDescription: There are days when we do not need quick answers, but words that help us remain before God. This three-day journey offers biblical guidance for praying when the heart is tired, when there are matters beyond our control, and when we need to recover hope. These are not formulas for avoiding pain, but sincere ways of bringing it to God and continuing to walk with him.

title: When You Don't Know What to Say to God
shortDescription: There are moments when prayer runs out of words. Weariness, sadness, confusion, or even guilt can make approaching God feel difficult. This five-day journey will help you discover that prayer does not always mean saying a lot: it can also mean remaining, sighing, reading a biblical prayer, being silent, and allowing the Spirit to sustain what you do not know how to express.

title: Faith to Face the Unknown
shortDescription: The unknown can awaken fear even when we know God is with us. New seasons, important decisions, unexpected changes, and paths we do not yet understand can make us feel insecure. Over nine days, you will learn to face what lies ahead without depending on having everything under control, discern with wisdom, move forward in obedience, prepare without anxiety, and trust that God can guide you even when the next chapter has not yet been written.

title: When Your Faith Feels Weak
shortDescription: There are days when believing feels harder than usual. Prayer is difficult, doubts weigh heavily, and what once seemed firm begins to feel fragile. This four-day journey will help you look at your weakness without condemning yourself, return to the truths that sustain faith, depend on God's grace when your strength is lacking, and keep moving forward with small but sincere steps.

title: When God Seems Silent
shortDescription: There are seasons when we pray, seek direction, and wait for an answer, yet everything seems to remain silent. That silence can create doubt, weariness, and the feeling that God is far away. Over seven days, you will explore biblical passages that teach you how to remain faithful when there are no immediate answers, distinguish silence from abandonment, pray honestly, stand on what God has already said, and wait without allowing the lack of clarity to extinguish your faith.

title: Trusting God in the Midst of Uncertainty
shortDescription: There are seasons when we do not know what will happen, when an answer will come, or why God allows certain processes. Uncertainty can awaken fear, urgency, and a need for control, but it can also become a place where faith matures. Over fourteen days, you will learn to trust God's character when you do not have all the answers, wait without becoming paralyzed, discern with wisdom, obey with the light available, and move forward with hope even when the full path is not yet visible.

title: The Transforming Love of God
shortDescription: God's love does more than comfort: it also corrects, restores, renews, and forms a new life. Over ten days, you will discover how his love reaches your identity, heals distorted thoughts, confronts habits, transforms relationships, and produces obedience that flows from grace. This biblical journey will help you move from simply knowing that God loves you to living in a way shaped by that love.

title: Healing the Heart to Love Again
shortDescription: After disappointment, betrayal, or a relationship that left wounds behind, loving again can feel risky. This biblical journey does not suggest forgetting what you lived through or rushing trust. Over eight days, you will learn to recognize what still hurts, bring it honestly before God, heal interpretations born from fear, establish wise boundaries, and recover the ability to relate to others without allowing the past to rule your heart.

title: Love Without Carrying the Past
shortDescription: Yesterday's wounds can quietly enter today's relationships: an old betrayal can become suspicion, a painful word can become distance, and a disappointment can become fear of trusting again. This biblical journey does not invite you to erase history or pretend that nothing happened. Over five days, you will learn to bring the past before God, distinguish memory from resentment, heal patterns that affect the way you love, and move forward with grace, truth, and wise boundaries.

title: Love as God Loves
shortDescription: God's love is not a sentimental idea or a passing emotion. It is holy, patient, truthful, sacrificial, and able to transform the way we see and treat others. Over fourteen days, you will explore teachings from Jesus and other biblical passages that show how to receive this love, remain in it, and express it truthfully in conversations, conflicts, service, forgiveness, boundaries, and everyday decisions.

title: A Living Faith for Ordinary Days
shortDescription: There are days without surprising answers, intense emotions, or visible changes. It is precisely there that faith shows its roots: when you choose to trust, keep your word, treat others with love, and continue doing good. These readings explore a sincere spirituality that does not need spectacle in order to remain alive.

title: Clarity for seasons of confusion
shortDescription: When many voices, possibilities, and fears compete for your attention, thinking calmly can seem impossible. This journey offers a biblical process for organizing what you know, recognizing what influences you, seeking wisdom, and moving forward with humility, even when God does not immediately show the complete picture.

title: When God works on your character
shortDescription: Character is formed away from applause: in the reaction you choose to restrain, the correction you accept, and the faithfulness you maintain when no one is watching you. These readings show how to cooperate with God’s work without confusing transformation with perfectionism or growth with condemnation.

title: Finding God in everyday life
shortDescription: God is not limited to temples, gatherings, or extraordinary moments. His presence can also be recognized when beginning the morning, fulfilling a responsibility, listening to another person, or pausing in the midst of tiredness. This journey invites you to awaken spiritual attentiveness and turn ordinary life into a space of communion, gratitude, and purpose.

title: Praying for my family
shortDescription: 5 days to learn to intercede for the family with love, gratitude, and perseverance. Each day guides you to present specific needs before God, take care of your own attitudes, and trust that prayer also transforms the way you support those you love.

title: A Home Filled with Faith
shortDescription: A 7-day Bible plan to strengthen your family’s spiritual life, cultivate healthy relationships, and turn your home into a place where faith is lived out through love, prayer, and everyday actions.
